dct_description_sm: This is a dataset of information acquired of a historic Site in the Province of Ancoa (Italy), between the Carleton Immersive Media Studio (CIMS)(Carleton University) and the Dipartimento di Ingegneria Civile, Edile e dell’Architettura (Università Politecnica delle Marche) for training purposes.  This material can not be used for commercial purposes or use in any form without the permission of Dr. Mario Santana, the authors, and site custodians. The site access was provided Soprintendenza Archeologia Belle Arti e Paesaggio delle Marche - Sezione Archeologia. The data includes aerial images and 3D Scanning of the archaeological site of the Forum, images of the west elevation of the Soprintendenza building, and the east elevation of the Museo Archeologico Nazionale delle MarcheAlso a panoramic aerial image and some images of the people conducting the work have been included.
